result_text:
I fixed `exportJson` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. It now builds the `all_files.zip` entries from the configured aspect names instead of five fixed filenames. The module compiles and the tests matching `*DataExport*` pass, but I didn't run a renamed-aspect export, so the `buildAndDeployment` case itself is untested.

For each scope (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other, in that order) it gets the name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same method the loose `aspect_<name>.txt` files are written with. It reads that file from the text folder and uses the same name for the zip entry. With the default configuration the entries are unchanged. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`.

The old read of `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` was what threw and skipped the rest of the block. With that gone, `git-history.zip` is written again whenever `git-history.txt` exists.
